title: Moon over the Alligator
source: Port-authored engine-ready setup for this pass; canonical A01 setup is unknown. The fixed board is a legal one-turn line, not a GBA reconstruction.
notes: Book of Moon turns Cyber-Tech Alligator into 1600 DEF; Spear Dragon pierces for exactly 300 battle damage.

canon_reference.setup_status: unknown in A01; this pass ships an engine-ready authored setup
solution_steps: Summon Summoned Skull by tributing Dark Driceratops from the field.
Equip him with Axe of Despair.
Activate Tribute to the Doomed, discard Dark Hole and destroy Marshmallon.
Enter Battle Phase and attack with Summoned Skull.
